priceSnapshot.note: The 31 August endday report printed 78,806.6 at 19:35 COT with a REDUCE gate at a settled 1H close below 78,350.0 and an ADD gate at a settled 1H close above 79,256.0. NEITHER GATE FIRED, and the reduce gate survived on construction alone. Sequence overnight: the 01:00Z hour closed 78,407.3, the 02:00Z hour printed the session low of 78,183.3 - 166.7 points BELOW the reduce level - but closed back at 78,450.3, and every hour since has closed higher. The 05:00Z hour reached 79,219.6 and closed 79,175.4, 80.6 points short of the add gate, then faded. So the settled-close construction did exactly the job it was built for: an intrabar wick took out the level and the gate correctly ignored it. Net against the endday read, spot is -20.0 points, -0.03 percent - flat. Against the 24h open of 78,093.2 the day is +693.4 points, +0.89 percent. 24h high 79,256.0, 24h low 77,700.0. sessionRange below covers 00:40Z forward, the window this report inherits.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 78,150.0 with no reclaim on the next bar. The level is moved DOWN from the endday gate at 78,350.0 for a specific reason: the 02:00Z bar traded to 78,183.3, which is under that gate, and the market then rejected it and rallied 1,036 points in three hours. The old gate only survived because it required a settled close. Placing the new gate beneath the low that has now been tested and defended - 636.6 points under spot, 1.57 hourly ATRs on a 405.5 reading - keeps it far outside the 0.4-to-0.6 ATR band where this desk has logged nine whipsaws, and anchors it to a price that actually rejected the market rather than to a round number.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 79,401.4, the 30 August rejection high. This is the first add-gate built to the rule the 31 August endday lesson demanded. The 79,256.0 gate that endday carried is deliberately NOT reused: it sits only 145 points under 79,401.4, and both realized liquidation clusters above spot - 79,000 at 1,637,876 USD and 79,250 at 716,899 USD - have already been consumed, so a trigger there has less than one hourly ATR of unconsumed room and would be buying information rather than profit. Above 79,401.4 the next structural level is 79,839.3, 437.9 points away, which is 1.08 hourly ATRs. That clears the test.

decisionBox.changed: Bias unchanged at range with a bullish tilt, confidence trimmed from 6.00 to 5.50. Two structural changes. FIRST, the single largest overnight unknown the endday report named has resolved BULLISH: Farside has now completed the 31 August row at +216.7m with IBIT filing +205.9m, so the incomplete +24.2m print is gone and the 28 August outflow of -201.9m stands as a one-day interruption rather than the start of a trend. SECOND, the macro turned hostile in the same window: US-Iran strikes pushed Brent to 91.20 (+0.78 percent), the US 10-year to 4.782 percent (+0.024) and the dollar index to 99.53, and September Fed rate-hike odds are being repriced after Warsh. Those two pull opposite ways, which is why the tilt stays but the confidence comes down. The gates are both rebuilt: reduce moves down 200 points to sit under a tested low, add moves up 145.4 points to the first level with more than one ATR of clean room above it.

liquidityMagnet.note: Raw skew reads DOWN and it is not close: 8,567,552 USD sits across five buckets below spot against 2,354,775 USD across two above, 3.6-to-1. Read it with the right caveat, though - these are REALIZED fills, they mark where positions died, not where stops rest. Both sides have now been worked once in this session: the downside shelf was consumed on the 02:00Z flush to 78,183.3 and the overhead pair was consumed on the 05:00Z push to 79,219.6. What is genuinely informative is the 24-hour aggregate: 4,348,071 USD of long liquidations against 6,574,256 USD of short. A market that has liquidated 1.5 dollars of shorts for every dollar of longs while grinding sideways is being carried by short covering, not by fresh leveraged demand - and short covering is a fuel that runs out.

divergences.note: Regular bearish divergence, computed not asserted. The 24 August daily printed a high of 81,280.0 with RSI(14) at 86.65; the 27 August daily printed a HIGHER high of 81,499.9 with RSI at 72.35 - 14.30 points lower. Price made the new high on materially less momentum. It resolved: the 28 August session sold to 76,888.0, a 4,611.9-point unwind, and BTC has not revisited 80,000 since. The divergence is spent as a trade but it explains why the daily RSI at 71.36 today is a fourth consecutive overbought reading inside a market that is 3.3 percent BELOW where that overbought condition started - the oscillator is elevated because the base is high, not because thrust is building. That is the reason today's tranche is the smallest of the ladder.

calibration.note: The finding is that the CONSTRUCTION change is working even though the scoreboard has not caught up. The endday reduce gate at 78,350.0 was breached intrabar - the 02:00Z bar traded 78,183.3, a 166.7-point overshoot - and the settled-1H-close requirement correctly refused to fire it. Price then rallied 1,036 points to 79,219.6 within three hours. Under the morning's construction, which fired on a 234-point overshoot at 77,950.0, that gate would have dumped the book at the low of the day for the second time in twenty-four hours. Two sessions running, the wider gate plus settled-close rule has avoided a whipsaw that the narrow gate walked into. The add side is where the work is still owed, and today is the first gate built to the 31 August lesson: 79,401.4 rather than 79,256.0, chosen because both overhead liquidation buckets are already consumed and the nearest unconsumed structure above 79,256.0 is only 145 points away, well under one hourly ATR.
